entities.summary: Swapnote, known as Nintendo Letter Box in Europe and Australia, and Suddenly Exchange Diary in Japanese, is a messaging application exclusive to the Nintendo 3DS. It was released in December 2011 on the Nintendo eShop. Swapnote was the successor to PictoChat for the Nintendo DS.
